name: kids-wifi-schedule
goal: Schedule the kids network off at night and on in the morning, weekday times when either kid has school, configured from a #kids_wifi popup on Home.

userStories.title: Helpers and school sensors
userStories.description: input_boolean.kids_wifi_schedule + four time input_datetimes (no initial:) in kids_wifi_schedule_helpers.yaml; binary_sensor.kids_school_tomorrow/today template sensors in kids_wifi_school_sensors.yaml
acceptanceCriteria: No initial: key in packages/network/kids_wifi/
kids_school_tomorrow = primary OR parochial in_session_tomorrow via is_state(...,'on'); kids_school_today likewise with _today
No availability: block on either sensor
Duplicates/naming tests pass; no kids_wifi_* basename collisions

userStories.title: Off automation
userStories.description: kids_wifi_off_on_schedule.yaml, alias 'Kids WiFi - Off on Schedule'
acceptanceCriteria: Time triggers on weekday/weekend off helpers with ids weekday_off/weekend_off
Conditions in order: schedule on, switch on, trigger.id->helper timestamp>0 guard (no trigger.entity_id), weekday_off<->kids_school_tomorrow on / weekend_off<->off
switch.turn_off with target block
8-case table holds

userStories.title: On automation
userStories.description: kids_wifi_on_on_schedule.yaml, alias 'Kids WiFi - On on Schedule'
acceptanceCriteria: Mirrors task-2 with on helpers (weekday_on/weekend_on), switch off, kids_school_today, switch.turn_on
8-case table holds with today

userStories.title: Restart catch-up

acceptanceCriteria: Triggers: homeassistant start + event_template_reloaded
Conditions: schedule on, switch off, window template (today's on <= now < tonight's off, both helpers set)
switch.turn_on
Host renders: before/inside/after window and unset helper give False/True/False/False
